description.value: Premier Lake Provincial Campground sits on the shore of Premier Lake in the East Kootenays, a full-service provincial site with showers and drinking water well-suited to a rest day; open year-round but services are seasonal and self-sufficiency is required outside the operating window.

address.value: 1 Premier Lake Park Rd, Skookumchuck, BC V0B 2E0, Canada
